description: Boundary: omp's outgoing Steering and After yield groups coexist with a genuine incoming Ask cursor picker. Source-derived synthetic plain-text queued band (queued-messages.ts/ui-helpers.ts) plus the Ask shape already covered by 62_omp_ask_picker. Queue numbering restarts at 1 in each group, a multiline outgoing message is flattened to literal spaced ↵ rather than wrapped, and a queued user question is not the live ask. The queue must not suppress the real color question or turn its unnumbered cursor options into a numbered menu. No dim styling is required, and the edit binding uses the source-supported macOS hint rather than assuming Alt+↑. This is not a runtime capture.
